nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Called by the 'send_line_flex' tool. userId is wired from the parent workflow; the model supplies altText and contentsJson.

nodes.name: Parse Flex
nodes.notes: The model hands over Flex JSON as a string. Parsing it here turns a malformed payload into a message the agent can act on, instead of a raw zod dump from the MCP server.

nodes.name: Push LINE Flex
nodes.notes: Regular MCP Client node: arguments are built here, so the flex JSON schema (full of const/anyOf) never reaches the model.

nodes.name: Tool Result
nodes.notes: Last node of the sub-workflow: this is what the agent receives as the tool result.
